name: fig36_holographic_entropy_ads3_btz
caption: Ryu-Takayanagi lengths with L = 1, G_N = 1. (a) The closed-form Poincare AdS3 geodesic length and a numerical quadrature of the semicircle agree. (b) In BTZ the connected geodesic competes with the horizon-wrapping candidate; they cross at Delta phi = 5.5919 (the cutoff cancels). The minimum encodes the Araki-Lieb behaviour S(A) - S(A^c) = (horizon length)/4G. (c) Entropy S = min(length)/4G_N; the kink marks the switch to the horizon-wrapping candidate and moves toward 2 pi as r_+ increases (about 5.59 at r_+ = 1), so for large r_+ the entropy is the connected-geodesic (extensive thermal) result over almost the whole circle. An independent turning-radius integration reproduces the connected closed form to 1.2e-07. Central charge c = 3L/2G_N; only the 2D vacuum and BTZ geometries are treated.
